description: This PHP class defines a model for bank transfer payment method within the OpenCart framework. It includes logic to determine the availability of the payment method based on geo zones, subscription status, and configuration settings, and provides data about the payment method for the checkout process.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Model class representing the bank transfer payment method, including logic for availability and configuration.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves the available bank transfer payment options based on various conditions such as geo zone and subscription status.
